answers.how: Measured cup height ≈257 px, giving 0.105/257 m/px. A local quadratic fit to cup positions gives ≈1340 px/s at 1.00 s.
Using the same height scale, the fitted cup velocity at 1.10 s is ≈1500 px/s.
Using the same height scale, the fitted cup velocity at 1.20 s is ≈1663 px/s.
A local quadratic fit over 0.90–1.30 s gives acceleration ≈1630 px/s²; multiplying by 0.105/257 gives ≈0.67 m/s².
